title: Is autism more common in boys or girls?
metaTitle: Gender Differences in Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Autism's occurrence leans more towards boys than girls, but why is that so? Learn more about the gender differences in autism at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: Indeed, the occurrence of autism is more frequent in boys than in girls, usually around four times more. However, this data also reflects the research focus on boys over the years. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we stress the importance of early diagnosis and intervention, irrespective of gender, as it greatly enhances the quality of life and increases the potential for improved outcomes.
